description: Runs the site's acquisition underwriting model on one commercial property: NOI, going-in cap rate, yield on cost, loan, equity, DSCR, debt yield, cash-on-cash, break-even occupancy, levered and unlevered IRR, equity multiple, transfer tax, and the most you can pay to reach a target levered IRR. The loan rate defaults to today's 10-year Treasury plus 204 bp.

amortization_years.description: Amortization in years; 0 = interest only. Default 25.

buyer_pays_transfer_tax.description: True if the buyer pays the transfer tax, which then adds to the cost basis.

capex.description: Repairs and capital work planned at purchase, US dollars. Default 0.

closing_costs.description: Other closing costs (legal, title, lender fees, reports), US dollars. Default 0.

gross_income.description: Gross potential rent and other income, annual, US dollars.

hold_years.description: Hold period in years, 1 to 30. Default 5.

interest_rate_pct.description: Loan interest rate, percent. Default: latest 10-year Treasury + 2.04.

ltv_pct.description: Loan-to-value on the price, percent. Default 65.

noi_growth_pct.description: NOI growth per year, percent. Default 3.

operating_expenses.description: Operating expenses including taxes and insurance, annual, US dollars.

price.description: Purchase price in US dollars, e.g. 5000000.

sale_cost_pct.description: Sale costs at exit, percent of sale price. Default 2.

target_irr_pct.description: Target levered IRR for the max-price answer, percent. Default 12.

transfer_tax_where.description: Where the deed records, for the transfer tax estimate: nyc, nys (outside NYC), fl (outside Miami-Dade), miami-dade, la (City of Los Angeles) or none.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and credit loss, percent of gross. Default 7.

name: underwrite_property
title: Underwrite a commercial property purchase
